desc: Archangel: white and gold plate armor dress, three stacked layers of huge feathered wings on each side, long flowing white cape, gold winged headpiece, holds a gold spear. Chibi 16-bit pixel art character sprite, big head, small body, right-facing 3/4, 1px navy outline, 2-3 flat shades, no gradients, no noise, no glow, no halo, no shadow. Black void face with small eyes. Palette lavender, white, violet, gold.
